concept: Seeking disconfirming evidence for your own strongly-held views, not just supporting evidence
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic scenario where an adult holds a strong view (professional, financial, personal) that has gone unchallenged for a long time
exercise.reflection_prompt: What evidence, if you found it, would actually change your mind here?
exercise.practice: Adult identifies one specific piece of disconfirming evidence they haven't actively looked for

assessment.success_marker: adult names a real, checkable piece of evidence rather than a hypothetical or vague one
